_comment: Known state -> cluster mapping for the multi-VM deployment (see
deploy/DEPLOY_GCP.md). Each cluster is one Hik-Connect account and one
emulator, on its own VM. When a VM is set up, its .env CM_STATE_NAME and
CM_CLUSTER_NAME must match one of these spellings exactly - a typo here
silently splits one cluster into two on the dashboard's
State -> Cluster -> Clinic drill-down, rather than erroring anywhere.
Not read by any code yet - this is the reference list a human copies
from when configuring a new VM. Update it here first whenever a new
cluster is added, so it stays the one source of truth for spelling.
